info.title: API.SH: QuintoAndar
info.description: The QuintoAndar API from API.SH: public QuintoAndar data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One QuintoAndar home: type, status, rent and sale availability, rent, condo fee, IPTU, home insurance, service fee, total monthly cost, sale price, rental guarantee range, area, rooms, parking, floor range, construction year, pets, furnished, subway, availability, description, every amenity and building installation, nearby places, captioned photos, video, listing history (first and last publication per business) and visit status. Also `cost_breakdown` (rent, condo fee, IPTU, home insurance, service fee, total, and how condo fee and IPTU are charged), `comfort_features` and `practical_features` (the home's comfort and practicality items, such as air conditioning, bathtub, built-in wardrobes), `macro_region`, `visits_available` and `direct_offer_allowed`. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/quintoandar-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Home id (the number in quintoandar.com.br/imovel/<id>). Or give `url`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. location), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: QuintoAndar homes to rent or buy
get.description:
Homes on QuintoAndar in a Brazilian city or neighbourhood, to rent or buy, with price (total monthly cost, rent or sale price), bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, area, home type, furnished, pets and near-subway filters and sort. Each result has id, link, type, rent, total monthly cost, condo plus IPTU, sale price, area, rooms, parking, furnished, pets, subway, street, neighbourhood, region, city, coordinates, installations, amenities, tags, rental yield, publication date and captioned photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/quintoandar-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: QuintoAndar place slug: city (sao-paulo-sp-brasil, rio-de-janeiro-rj-brasil, belo-horizonte-mg-brasil...) or neighbourhood (pinheiros-sao-paulo-sp-brasil).

parameters.name: price_type
parameters.description: For rent: filter on the total monthly cost (default) or the rent alone.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The listing page's similar-homes shelves on QuintoAndar: similar homes nearby and in the same neighbourhood, each with the same fields as /quintoandar/v1/search (price, costs, size, rooms, address, position, amenities, images, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/quintoandar-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing number (or a listing link in `url`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
